open.title: Errors and stalled predictions on some models
open.text:
The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

Current impact: prediction requests for some models may return HTTP 500 errors, and some predictions may stay in a processing state. Customers using the API may also see validation errors on responses.

open.title: Changes to Cloudflare Workers are not producing Event Subscription events
open.text: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

open.title: Claude unable to join meetings
open.text:

open.title: SMS Delivery Delays from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes to Liberty Mobile Puerto Rico
open.text: We have observed a recovery in SMS delivery from a subset of Twilio Short Codes to Liberty Mobile network subscribers in Puerto Rico and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 4 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: Voice Call Post Dial Delay, Audio Quality Degradation, and Silent and One-Way Audio Between Twilio Phone Numbers and Brazil
open.text: Twilio customers may be experiencing voice call post dial delay, audio quality degradation, and silent and one-way audio between Twilio Phone Numbers and network subscribers in Brazil. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: SMS Delivery Failures Between a Subset of Twilio Short Codes and Claro in Brazil
open.text: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery failures between a subset of Twilio Short Codes and Claro network subscribers in Brazil. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Brisanet Servicos De Telecomunicacoes SA Brazil
open.text: We have observed a recovery in SMS delivery from Twilio to Brisanet Servicos De Telecomunicacoes SA network subscribers in Brazil and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 4 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: Voice Call Audio Quality Degradation Between Twilio and Multiple Networks in United Kingdom
open.text: Twilio customers may be experiencing voice call audio quality degradation between Twilio and network subscribers on multiple networks in the United Kingdom. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 4 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: Voice Call Failures from a Subset of Twilio Philippines Phone Numbers to Multiple Networks in Philippines
open.text: Twilio customers may be experiencing voice call failures from a subset of Twilio Philippines Phone Numbers to network subscribers on multiple networks in the Philippines. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 24 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: Voice Call Silent and One-Way Audio from Colombia to a Subset of Twilio Phone Numbers
open.text: Twilio customers may be experiencing voice call silent and one-way audio from network subscribers in Colombia to a subset of Twilio Phone Numbers. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 24 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: SMS Delivery Receipt Delays from a Subset of Twilio Long Codes to Multiple Networks in Chile
open.text: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery receipt delays from a subset of Twilio Long Codes to network subscribers on multiple networks in Chile. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. Message delivery may succeed, but delivery receipts may be delayed. We will provide another update in 24 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: Memecore (M) Deposits Disabled
open.text: Withdrawals for Memecore (M) are available again. As a precautionary measure, deposits have been disabled. Further updates will be communicated separately.

open.title: Stablr USD (USDR) and Stablr Euro (EURR) Funding Methods Halted
open.text: We are continuing to work on a fix for this issue.

open.title: ACH Deposits Cancelled
open.text: A fix has been implemented for the issue affecting ACH deposits, and ACH deposits can now be initiated again. Deposits that were cancelled did not move any funds, and customers can resubmit them. We are monitoring to confirm that deposits continue to complete successfully.
